title: Flatten your code with early returns

publish.title: Flatten your code with early returns
publish.description: A before-and-after example of replacing nested ifs with guard clauses.

scenes.headline: Flatten your code
scenes.narration: If your function drifts to the right of the screen, there is an easy fix.

scenes.headline: Deep nesting hides the point
scenes.narration: When every check wraps the next one, the real work ends up buried on the right side of the screen.

scenes.headline: Before: nested checks
scenes.narration: Here every condition opens another level, and the one line that matters sits four levels deep.

scenes.headline: After: early returns
scenes.narration: Check the bad cases first and return early. The happy path then reads straight down.

scenes.headline: Why it helps
scenes.narration: Less indentation means less to hold in your head, and the main path is easy to find.
items: The main path is easy to find

scenes.headline: Try it on one function
scenes.narration: Pick one nested function today and flatten it.
